chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Touring with Helvey: Charleston, Dallas and Adolphus Trent
summary: Helvey's band traveled widely; he met Margaret in Charleston and heard Adolphus Trent's band in Dallas.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Where did you play with Wes Helvey?
We played all over... That's where I met my wife, down in Charleston. We played down in Charleston, that's where I met her.
Oh, so you used to travel?
Yeah, we did lots of traveling.
Did you encounter any other people, day other bands and things like that during your traveling? Did you meet other musicians out of other bands?
Who were some of the people that you met at that time?
... We played out in Dallas and I met Alphonse (Adolphus?) Trent's band. He had one of the best bands in Dallas.
Adolphus Trent. Stuff Smith was playing with him then.
Do you remember what year this was?
You worked with Wes Helvey's band from 1924, you said, until about when? How long?
I worked with him until 1927 when they sent for me to come here.
